records.subject: Composite matrix
records.quote: Although UV-Vis indicates an electronically insulating matrix, mechanistic analysis shows that thermovoltage is governed primarily by pore-electrolyte-driven ionic thermoelectricity: pore-solution extraction confirms an orders-of-magnitude higher ionic inventory (very high Na+ concentration); FTIR and 29Si/27Al MAS solid-state NMR resolve activator-controlled gel polymerization and alkali binding that regulate the free-ion population; and TGA together with mercury intrusion porosimetry identify moisture-enabled electrolyte continuity and pore-hierarchy effects that control ionic mobility and thermodiffusion-driven voltage generation.
modality_evidence: Although UV-Vis indicates an electronically insulating matrix, mechanistic analysis shows that thermovoltage is governed primarily by pore-electrolyte-driven ionic thermoelectricity: pore-solution extraction confirms an orders-of-magnitude higher ionic inventory (very high Na+ concentration); FTIR and 29Si/27Al MAS solid-state NMR resolve activator-controlled gel polymerization and alkali binding that regulate the free-ion population; and TGA together with mercury intrusion porosimetry identify moisture-enabled electrolyte continuity and pore-hierarchy effects that control ionic mobility and thermodiffusion-driven voltage generation.

records.subject: 40(Cu1−xAgxI)–45(Ag2O)–15(B2O3), 0.05 ≤ x ≤ 0.25
records.quote: Evaluation of electrical transport and structural characteristics of the pseudo ternary system 40(Cu1-xAgxI)-45(Ag2O)-15(B2O3), where 0.05 less than or equal to x less than or equal to 0.25 has been reported.
context_quotes: Electrical conductivity measurements were made using complex impedance method.

The extent of contribution of ionic conductivity to the total electrical conductivity in various compositions of the above system was determined by evaluating their ionic transport numbers (t(i)) using Wagner's method and the corresponding silver ionic transport numbers (t(Ag+)) by the E.M.F. technique.
These measurements have indicated the formation of superionic materials having electrical conductivities of the order of 10(-4) to 10(-3) S cm(-1) at room temperature.
modality_evidence: Electrical conductivity measurements were made using complex impedance method.

The extent of contribution of ionic conductivity to the total electrical conductivity in various compositions of the above system was determined by evaluating their ionic transport numbers (t(i)) using Wagner's method and the corresponding silver ionic transport numbers (t(Ag+)) by the E.M.F. technique.
These measurements have indicated the formation of superionic materials having electrical conductivities of the order of 10(-4) to 10(-3) S cm(-1) at room temperature.

records.quote: Evaluation of electrical transport and structural characteristics of the pseudo ternary system 40(Cu1-xAgxI)-45(Ag2O)-15(B2O3), where 0.05 less than or equal to x less than or equal to 0.25 has been reported.
context_quotes: Electrical conductivity measurements were made using complex impedance method.
